items.title: Make the app and browser suites run on NixOS with PostgreSQL tools from Nix

checks.command: KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task21 nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build && dev/kasvimuseo app test'
KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task21 KASVIMUSEO_BROWSER_ENGINES=chromium nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build && dev/kasvimuseo app browser-test'

test "$(git diff --name-only e25beb848cedd90265b144ba05e1282f401289cf 1e3038f4ad31f13967e1629b75de242174ba775f | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'README.rst dev/kasvimuseo ' && test "$(git rev-list --reverse e25beb848cedd90265b144ba05e1282f401289cf..1e3038f4ad31f13967e1629b75de242174ba775f | tr '\n' ' ')" = '2ee8d1b4f2a394069316aa05a80ab15e15fb9136 0c4464f8107e0b9e4664aa6f8fc114d1de9190e2 76e60d903c07d758df815f0363318273af612eae 1e3038f4ad31f13967e1629b75de242174ba775f ' && echo ok

added=$(git diff e25beb848cedd90265b144ba05e1282f401289cf 1e3038f4ad31f13967e1629b75de242174ba775f | grep '^+' || true) && test -n "$added" && ! grep -nE '/home/|/tmp/claude|tinni|atom|hopeli|gogo|[.]kandev|[.]t3/' <<<"$added" && echo ok

app-test.command: KASVIMUSEO_IMAGE=kasvimuseo-dev-task21 nix-shell -p postgresql --run 'dev/kasvimuseo app build && dev/kasvimuseo app test'
